body.claim: The prefix list must not gain notes/, because CLAUDE.md deliberately points at an untracked file there.
body.detail: notes/ is gitignored and holds notes/WRITING.md, the prose rules CLAUDE.md requires reading before any documentation change. It is untracked on purpose: it governs how this repository is written rather than what the product does. Because this function only collects paths under crates/, docs/, conformance/, editors/ and xtask/, the reference is never checked for existence. Adding notes/ to that list would pass locally and fail CI on every clean clone, where the file does not exist, with an error naming the wrong problem.
